## Out of scope?

This repo is a thin MCP wrapper. New tools require a corresponding endpoint
on the public Roamzy API (`https://roamzy.io/api/v1/*`). If your request
would need a backend change too, it's worth flagging in the issue so we
can route it correctly — service-level features go through
`@roamzy_support_bot` on Telegram or `support@roamzy.io`.
